# Org2

> Org2 is a local-first knowledge compiler and runtime for Org-shaped plain text. Ordinary .org2 and .org files are canonical; agendas, graph data, context packets, reports, editor behavior, apps, and websites derive from the shared compiler/runtime.

Installed agents should begin with:

    org2 agent capabilities
    org2 --help
    org2 agent --help

The first command emits the machine-readable `org2:capabilities:v1` manifest. Mutating commands generally preview unless `--apply` is provided. Preserve citations, IDs, provenance, and review state; place generated work in `views/` or `compiled/` before promotion into canonical notes.

The native macOS Workspace also exposes a discoverable chat slash-command layer. Its local commands reuse shared search, backlink, lint, render, and publish semantics; agent-assisted `/brief` and `/summarize` receive selected source context with citations. See the macOS Workspace reference for the current command catalog.
